_doc: Clip theo lỗi L1 của người học ngôn ngữ này (docs/specs/social-l1-clips.md). Giáo viên nói tiếng Anh ≤B1; native.* = bản tay (tầng i18n-fixed), {m:từ[#nghĩa]} lấy nghĩa từ web/packs/<lang>.json (vi: kho từ).

mistake.en: I am agree (instead of I agree)
mistake.vi: "I am agree" thay vì "I agree" (tiếng Pháp: je suis d'accord)

segments.text: Don't say, I am agree. Say, I agree.
Agree is already a verb, so we do not need am.
Repeat after me. I agree. She agrees with me.

native.caption: En français on dit « je suis d’accord », mais en anglais “agree” est déjà un verbe : “I agree”, pas “I am agree”. Répète avec Carlos et travaille la grammaire dans l’appli Lexkite.

en.caption: In French you say “je suis d’accord”, but in English “agree” is already a verb: “I agree”, not “I am agree”. Repeat with Carlos and practice grammar in the Lexkite app.
